'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Joe Olson DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Olson]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration]]
* '''Username:''' A Rebel Spy
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
